inputs.shape: Exactly five own data fields; no getter reads, inherited fields or extras. Byte fields accept actual nonshared/non-detached Uint8Array or ArrayBuffer, snapshotted with intrinsic bounds.
inputs.urlBytes: 1..255B printable ASCII; observed limited case-insensitive http(s) prefix/first-host-byte guard, no full URL or origin validation
inputs.launcherPathBytes: 4..259B printable ASCII, initial ASCII letter + colon + backslash
inputs.archiveSizeBytes: 1..10decimal ASCII bytes, numeric1..268435456, original leading zeros retained
inputs.launcherMd5Bytes: Exactly32ASCII hexadecimal bytes, original letter case retained
inputs.common_url_path_guard: No pipe, double quote, control, DEL, leading/trailing SP; internal SP allowed

transformation: Copy URL/path, replace each internal0x20 with0x7c, then decimal PID URL path original-size original-MD5 separated by four0x20 bytes; no terminating NUL in logical result.

output.argumentBytes: Owned mutable Uint8Array, maximum570B; result record frozen; independent of all inputs and other calls
output.archiveBytes: Numeric parsed size; no payload allocation/download

policy_boundaries: ASCII-only and strict own field/byte ownership are independent narrower policies; no claim of full native MBCS/locale behavior.
Profile sourceSha256 identifies the analyzed formatter algorithm, not the supplied path, installed file or remote publisher.
256MiB describes serialized native size text only; existing ZIP/download core remains32MiB, not widened.
Pure shared module has no Node/DOM/wx/process/event/file/network APIs. No page integration or native executor is added.
Formatting does not validate file existence, executable identity, signature, shell safety, handoff readiness, ACK, replacement, rollback or official acceptance.
meaningful_tests: Golden original bytes with repeated internal spaces, leading zeros and mixed-case digest
Exact570B upper bound and independently distinct numerical/text bounds
Own descriptors/getters, subclasses, views, buffer mutation, shared/detached/proxy input rejection
unresolved: Original game consumer/protocol and playable implementation
Real authentication and physical mobile/WeChat/official acceptance
